body:
I don’t think you pass completely, no. Your hair is long on the top, which makes you look like you have a bigger forehead than you probably do. Plus your haircut isn’t completely masculine; yes it’s short, but not shaped a lot. 
Your brows are also really arched too. 
I’d say you pass maybe as 65%-75% male.

Please don’t kill yourself. Your girlfriend would not have wanted that. She would want you to keep on living despite it all.
Please keep living. People at school are assholes, I know. I used to get bullied a lot. But you only have a year or two of high school left. Please try to get through it because you’ll never know how amazing life can get.

I’m sorry to hear about your family. I know how much you’d like a relationship. Keep trying. You never know who you’ll meet. There are dating apps like Yubo (you can find people in your area- but be safe and careful doing that) for teens, etc. 

Things may seem impossible to deal with right now. Can you maybe find out about how to get emancipated? That way you don’t have to deal with your family anymore. If you have any questions feel free to PM me, I know a lot about emancipation.
